summary: Verified replay transport/export: 28/28 unit+regression tests pass invoking production code; typecheck clean. Core unit-seam ACs (3,6,7,9,15/17 helpers,20 predicates) covered; browser/integration ACs (1–2,4–5,8,10–14,16,18–19, UI chrome) documented as residual risk per architecture harness plan — not needs_revision.
goal: Climb replay should allow fast forwarding, rewind, pause/play. Export as mp4.

coverageMatrix.evidence: ClimbScene mounts ReplayTransportBar when replaying && phase!==lobby && transport; live path skips mount. No automated render test.
ReplayTransportBar uses min-h/min-w-[44px]; no layout measurement test.
shouldCaptureReplayKey positive keys + interactive exemption + unbound keys.
pause() sets pausedRef; wall-clock freeze needs rAF/fake-clock harness (architecture §14 did not list as unit seam).
play() clears pause; resume timing needs browser/fake-clock harness.
ReplaySnapshotCache.seek/seekToTick vs headless oracle y/peakY/tick; rewind 150→50; clone isolation.
tickFromSeekRatio(0,0.5,1) for N=101; seek(0) playable climb phase.
restartReplay wired (speed 1, playing, start); no unit invoking restartReplay.
cycleReplaySpeed 1→2→4→1; REPLAY_SPEEDS=[1,2,4].
Architecture §14: fake-clock/browser harness. Not covered by node vitest.
pause/play no-op when finished; phaseLabel finished in transport view. No auto-advance stop test.
Controls are not gated on reducedMotion; no automated reduced-motion fixture.
useReplayExport 720×1280@30 detached canvas; MediaRecorder encode needs browser harness.
Double-start guarded (sessionRef); duration N/30 not unit-asserted; encode is browser.
pickExportMime extension/label honesty unit-tested. Filename climb-{peak}m-{yyyyMMdd} built in useReplayExport (unexported) — residual for filename string.
exportPercent private helper matches formula but not exported/tested; cancel/download need browser.
pickExportMime(()=>false)→null unit-tested; UI error string + 2s timing residual (browser).
visibility policy (b) in useReplayExport; architecture ADR-4 — browser harness.
failSession sets error status; encode failure needs MediaRecorder browser path.
shouldCaptureReplayKey(!replaying)=false; shouldCaptureGameKey Space during climb still true; interactive exemption both predicates. TouchControls mount residual (wiring only).
